text: Why did the cat sit on the newspaper?
The news was less important than the cat.
Why did the cat ignore his name?
He heard it. He simply disagreed.
What does a cat do when you call it?
Considers it. Files it away. Moves on.
Why did the cat sleep on the clean laundry?
It was warm and it was yours.
Why did the cat sit in the empty box?
The box was there. What else is there to say.
Why did the cat stare at the wall?
He knows something. He isn't telling.
What is a cat's favorite chair?
Whichever one you just got up from.
Why did the cat wake you at four in the morning?
The schedule is his, not yours.
Why did the cat bring you a bug?
It was a gift. Be gracious.
What does a cat think of a closed door?
A personal insult.
Why did the cat sit in the doorway?
In and out are both wrong. He is deciding.
What is a cat's exercise routine?
One sprint at midnight, then eleven hours of recovery.
Why did the cat sit on the keyboard?
You were paying attention to the wrong rectangle.
Why did the cat hide when company came?
He does not perform on request.
Why did the cat come out after they left?
He wanted to see what he had missed.
Why did the cat lie in the one sunny spot?
The rest of the house is decoration.
What does a cat do all day?
Whatever it was doing before you walked in.
Why did the cat knead the blanket?
Something ancient said to and he obeyed.
Why did the cat purr when you were sad?
He noticed. He would deny noticing.
What is the cat's opinion of the dog?
Long. Detailed. Unpublished.
Why did the cat watch the bird through the window?
Ambition costs nothing.
Why did the cat chatter at the bird?
Everyone has a plan they will never execute.
Why did the cat leave the expensive food?
It was purchased with hope.
Why did the cat eat the cheap food later?
On his own schedule. That was the point.
What does a cat do with a new toy?
Nothing. The wrapper, though.
Why did the cat sleep sixteen hours?
The other eight were exhausting.
Why did the cat run out of the room for no reason?
There was a reason. It was not shared.
Why did the cat sit on the puzzle?
It was almost finished and he could tell.
Why did the cat glare at the vacuum?
A grudge that will outlive the vacuum.
Why did the cat sit in the suitcase?
Nobody is leaving.
Why did the cat sit in the grocery bag?
Everybody is staying.
What does a cat do when you cry?
Sits down and waits it out with you.
Why did the cat follow you to the bathroom?
Supervision.
Why did the cat sit outside the shower?
In case something went wrong. Or right.
Why did the cat trip you on the stairs?
He was also going down. Timing is hard.
Why did the cat sit in the middle of the hallway?
It is his hallway. You have visiting rights.
What is a cat's opinion of the leash?
It was the worst afternoon of his life.
Why did the cat come when you opened a can?
The ears work. Everything works. He chooses.
Why did the cat sit and stare at you while you ate?
No reason. Just an audience.
Why did the cat bite you gently?
That was affection. You are lucky.
Why did the cat sleep on your chest?
To make sure the heart kept doing its job.
Why did the cat sit on the warm laptop?
Loyalty to whatever hums.
Why did the cat roll over and show his belly?
A trap dressed as a compliment.
Why did the cat sit on the mail?
Something arrived that was not for him.
Why did the cat chase nothing across the room?
Something was there. Trust him.
Why did the cat sit in the sink?
Cold, curved, and inexplicable. Like him.
What does a cat call a lap?
Furniture with a heartbeat.
Why did the cat abandon the lap?
He got what he came for.
Why did the cat sit on the windowsill all afternoon?
There was a leaf doing something.
Why did the cat ignore the expensive bed?
It did not smell like anybody.
Why did the cat sleep in the shoebox instead?
It did.
Why did the cat headbutt you?
You have been claimed. Congratulations.
What is a cat's plan for the day?
Locate warmth. Defend warmth.
Why did the cat meow at an empty bowl?
There was food in it. Not enough of it.
Why did the cat sit under the Christmas tree?
A forest arrived and it is indoors.
Why did the cat drink from the faucet?
There is a whole bowl. This one is running.
Why did the cat sit on the phone?
You were laughing at something that was not him.
Why did the cat lie across the doorway at night?
Somebody has to hold the line.
What does the cat do when you come home?
Appears. Says nothing. Has been waiting.
Why did the cat sit next to you and not on you?
That is as close as love gets to admitting itself.
Why was the dog thrilled you came home?
You were gone for eleven minutes.
Why did the dog greet you at the door?
In case you had forgotten you were loved.
What does a dog think of a car ride?
Best day. Every time. Without exception.
Why did the dog stick his head out the window?
The whole world was reporting in.
Why did the dog bring you his toy?
He had something and you deserved it.
Why did the dog drop the ball at your feet again?
It worked the first four hundred times.
Why did the dog wag before you said anything?
He liked your odds.
What is a dog's opinion of the mailman?
Complicated. Loud. Renewed daily.
Why did the dog bark at the doorbell on television?
Somebody could be here. It costs nothing to check.
Why did the dog sit when you picked up the leash?
Composure. Barely.
Why did the dog spin in a circle first?
The excitement had to go somewhere.
Why did the dog sigh and lie down?
The day had been long and he had done all of it.
What does a dog do when you say his name?
Everything stops. You have his entire attention.
Why did the dog watch you eat?
In case a miracle occurred.
Why did the dog put his head on your knee?
He was checking on you.
Why did the dog follow you room to room?
You might need help. He is qualified.
Why did the dog stand outside while it snowed?
Weather is a thing that happens and he is willing.
Why did the dog roll in the grass?
It smelled magnificent and now so does he.
Why did the dog come running when you were sad?
He heard it in your voice before you did.
Why did the dog lick your hand?
There was nothing else he could do about it.
Why did the dog sleep against the door?
So he would hear you first.
Why did the dog learn to sit?
You clapped once, years ago.
Why did the dog eat something he found outside?
It was there. He is a professional.
Why did the dog look guilty?
He had no idea what he did but he is sorry.
Why did the dog bring you a stick?
It was the biggest thing he could carry.
Why did the dog carry a stick too big for the gate?
Reassessment takes time and he is not ready.
Why did the dog swim after nothing?
There was a duck. There is always a duck.
Why did the dog shake off next to you?
Sharing.
Why did the dog bark at the vacuum?
It came into his house making claims.
Why did the dog hide from the vacuum after?
Nobody is brave twice in one afternoon.
Why did the dog sit by the bowl an hour early?
Optimism is a lifestyle.
Why did the dog wag at the veterinarian?
He has never once learned.
Why was the dog delighted at the vet anyway?
New people. New smells. A whole outing.
Why did the dog forget where he buried it?
The joy was in the burying.
What do two dogs do at a fence?
Everything important, apparently.
Why did the dog nap in the sunny square on the floor?
The sun moved. He moved. This is the day.
Why did the dog nap again an hour later?
He had done a great deal of napping and was tired.
Why did the dog bark at his own reflection?
He was concerned. Then delighted. Then concerned.
Why did the dog tilt his head?
He almost understood you and it was close.
Why did the dog bring you a shoe?
It was yours and now it is nearer to you.
Why did the dog chew the shoe first?
He was making it his before making it yours.
Why did the dog get in the car before you opened the door?
Faith.
Why did the dog sit in the driver's seat?
Somebody has to be prepared.
Why was the dog happy about the rain?
There is a puddle situation developing.
Why did the dog track it inside?
Sharing, again.
Why did the dog sleep on his back with his feet up?
Nothing has ever gone wrong in his life.
Why did the dog snore louder than you?
He had earned it.
Why did the dog wake up instantly at the word walk?
He has been listening for it his entire life.
Why did the dog get excited when you put on shoes?
Shoes mean everything. Shoes mean anything.
Why was the dog disappointed you took out the trash?
It was a false alarm and he had gotten his hopes up.
Why did the dog forgive you immediately?
The next thing might be a walk.
Why did the dog lean against your leg?
Standing is easier with company.
Why did the dog sit on your foot?
He is keeping track of you.
Why did the dog wait by the window all afternoon?
He had a strong feeling about today.
Why was the dog right?
You came home. He is always right.
Why did the dog bark at the delivery truck?
It was leaving with information.
Why did the dog learn to open the door?
He had somewhere to be. It was here.
Why did the dog howl at the siren?
Someone was singing and it was rude not to answer.
Why did the dog stop chasing the squirrel?
He caught up to the idea and had no next step.
Why did the dog put his paw on your hand?
So you would stay a minute longer.
What does a goldfish do all day?
This. What you are watching. This is it.
Why did the goldfish swim to the glass?
Something enormous appeared. It was your face.
Why did the goldfish swim away?
He had seen enough of that.
Why did the fish stare at the little castle?
Real estate is a fascination in every species.
Why did the fish swim through the castle?
It is the only door in his life.
Why did the fish ignore the treasure chest?
It opens. It closes. He has opinions about neither.
What is the fish tank's most exciting event?
The lid. Somebody is coming.
Why did the fish eat immediately?
There is no such thing as later.
Why was the fish unbothered by the news?
It never reaches him.
What does a fish think of Monday?
Nothing whatsoever. Consider that.
Why does the fish never argue?
He has never once needed the last word.
Why did the fish look at the plastic plant?
It has been a good friend and asks nothing.
Why did the fish hide behind the filter?
Everyone needs somewhere.
What did the fish do when the light came on?
Began again. Cheerfully. As if new.
Why is the fish good company?
He never brings anything up.
Why did the fish tank get put in the waiting room?
Nobody has ever been made anxious by a fish.
What did the fish do when you talked to him?
Listened, arguably.
Why did the fish blow a bubble?
A statement, and then it was gone.
Why did the fish follow your finger on the glass?
Company is company.
Why was the fish the easiest pet?
He has never once needed anything from you at three in the morning.
Why did the fish outlive the hamster?
Ambition is expensive.
Why did the fish swim in circles?
The lane was open and he was already there.
Why did the fish go the other way?
Variety.
What is a fish's opinion of the ocean?
He has heard rumors.
Why did the betta flare at his reflection?
He met the only rival he will ever have.
Why did the betta calm down?
They came to an understanding, roughly.
What did the fisherman catch all day?
A sunrise, a sunburn, and a nap.
Why did the fisherman call it a good day?
Nobody asked him a single question for six hours.
Why did the fish get away?
He was enormous. Ask anybody who wasn't there.
How big was the fish that got away?
Bigger every year, and he is not done growing.
Why did the fisherman go back the next day?
Yesterday proved nothing.
What is a fisherman's favorite lie?
The one with a witness who has also been fishing.
Why did the fisherman fish where nothing bit?
He had made a promise to that spot.
Why did the fisherman not move to the good spot?
Then he would be the man who moved.
What is the best part of fishing?
The part where nothing is required of you.
Why did the fisherman bring a book?
Optimism has a backup plan.
Why did the fisherman never open the book?
The water kept almost doing something.
Why did the fisherman talk to the fish?
Somebody down there is listening.
What did the fish say back?
Exactly what you would expect. And it was correct.
Why did the fisherman throw it back?
He liked the fish by then.
Why did the fisherman take a picture first?
The fish will be bigger in the story and the picture is evidence.
Why did the fisherman fish alone?
So the story stays reliable.
Why did the boy catch more than his grandfather?
The grandfather was not fishing. He was watching the boy.
Why did the grandfather bring the boy fishing?
So the boy would learn how to sit still and be happy.
What did the boy catch?
Nothing. He remembers every minute of it.
Why did the fisherman keep the worst rod?
It has caught everything that ever mattered to him.
Why did the fisherman clean the tackle box in winter?
Hope needs somewhere to go in January.
Why did the fisherman organize the lures by color?
One of them will work. Probably the ugly one.
Why did the ugly lure work?
The fish have never been consulted on taste.
Why did the fisherman not tell anyone the spot?
There are three secrets a man keeps and this is two of them.
Why did the pond seem smaller than he remembered?
He was smaller then, and so was everything.
Why did the fisherman go back to the same pond for forty years?
It has never once disappointed him and it has never once cooperated.
Why did the fish jump out of the water?
Exuberance. There is no other explanation.
Why did the fish jump right beside the boat?
To be seen. Not caught. Seen.
Why did nobody believe the fisherman?
He is a fisherman.
Why did everybody listen anyway?
He is a fisherman.
What does a fisherman call a bad day?
A day. He does not have another word for it.
Why did the fisherman stay out past dark?
One more cast has never once been one more cast.
Why did the fisherman finally reel in?
His wife flashed the porch light twice.
Why did the fisherman smile all the way home?
The cooler was empty and the evening was not.
Why did the fisherman say fishing is not about fish?
Because he has caught almost none and loved every year of it.
